description: This Java class, DeleteThingStrategy, implements a command handling strategy for deleting a 'Thing' in the system. It constructs and returns a result indicating the deletion event, logs the operation, and manages entity tags.

classes.name: DeleteThingStrategy
classes.description: Implementing a command strategy that handles the deletion of a 'Thing' entity, logs the operation, and constructs the corresponding deletion event and response.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the delete command, logs the operation, creates a deletion event, and prepares the response with optional headers and entity tags.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag of the previous 'Thing' entity if available, useful for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty optional since deletion does not produce a new entity tag.
